title: Three.js
summary: 3D put through a photocopier: flat-shaded paper, plaster and wire in soot, bone and one red, broken into halftone dots and toner grain by a hand-written post pass. Scenes move on twos and twitch like stop-motion; dust and scratches change 8 times a second.
usage: {"piece": "three/paper-stack"}. Words are props, e.g. {"piece": "three/ransom-cubes", "props": {"word": "CHAOS"}}. Files: library/themes/grunge/three/pieces/ (shared look: _fx.js).

items.name: Paper stack
items.description: A collage table from above: torn sheets, red scraps, halftone offcuts and tape stacked in depth, sliding over each other as the camera drifts. Loops; the top scrap carries a typed label.

items.name: Plaster wall
items.description: A cracked plaster wall under a raking light that swings across it, with a word stencilled in chipped red paint. Loops; a background for titles and diagrams.

items.name: Chain link
items.description: Walking through layers of chain-link fence at night with a halftone moon behind and red rags knotted to the wire. Loops.

items.name: Crumpled paper
items.description: A balled-up sheet opens out in held steps until the words printed on it can be read, still creased under a side light.

items.name: Ransom cubes
items.description: Ransom-note letters as paper blocks, each cut from a different page, tumbling down onto a torn strip to spell a word.

items.name: Halftone globe
items.description: A globe printed as coarse halftone dots, turning inside a hand-drawn red orbit with a red pin stuck in it. Loops.

items.name: Vinyl spin
items.description: A record half out of its torn paper sleeve, spinning; grooves catch the light, the red label carries your text. Loops.
